notes: Run 2026-11-15. Very limited usable sources. WebFetch PROVENANCE_REQUIRED blocked vcnngr.gov.ng (Veterinary Council of Nigeria) and vet.ui.edu.ng/contactvettea; not retried. NVMA, UNN, UNAAB, Kano/Enugu/Port Harcourt/Benin/Jos/Calabar clinics: searches returned only aggregators (finelib, connectciti, businesslist, goafricaonline, jiji, starofservice, myguidenigeria), deliberately not used as sources. Leads not opened: Crimson Veterinary Centre Ibadan (insideoyo.com news article), Zoba Veterinary Hospital (myguidenigeria listing), Pets-Choice, Damos, Supervet Clinic and Surgery, Innova Veterinary Hospital, May Veterinary Clinic, Ritab Vet Clinics (Lagos), Vet Planet, Rapkin, Crystal Veterinary Services, Marshall Veterinary Clinic (Port Harcourt). FurryPaws Veterinary Healthcare (Kabusa, Abuja; austineasika.github.io/FurryPawsVetHealthcare/) opened but dropped: no phone listed (only WhatsApp link, +234 811 016 3833 implied), no hours, no 24 h claim, looks like a demo page. No duty rota and no animal poison line found.
